name: Instance
description: Application instance running on a server.

cloud_project_id.label: Cloud project
cloud_project_id.description: Cloud project of the server hosting the instance.

has_dns_record.label: DNS record
has_dns_record.description: Whether a managed DNS record exists for the instance.

action.backup.label: Create backup
action.backup.description: Create an encrypted backup of this instance and send it to the configured backup host.

action.restore-backup.label: Restore backup
action.restore-backup.description: Restore this instance from a backup available through its B2 server.

action.create-dns-record.label: Create DNS record
action.create-dns-record.description: Create or update the OVH A record for the instance.

errors.missing_b2_host_access: The B2 management access on port 8000 is missing.
